title: Night Drive
author: Drift
blurb: Neon highway, late radio, and a night that never ends.
facts: 8 tracks on one tape, sides A and B

menu.label: A1  MIDNIGHT ON-RAMP
menu.desc: Out of Port Solace on Shoreline 9, lamps sliding past.

menu.label: A2  VELVET SKYLINE
menu.desc: Parked at the lookout, Port Solace across Velvet Bay, a train on the bridge.

menu.label: A3  SUNDOWN GRID
menu.desc: The sun going down over the neon grid, one row every fifteen seconds.

menu.label: A4  COAST ROAD 86
menu.desc: Along the cliff road by the sea, moonlight on the water, a lighthouse ahead.

menu.label: B1  RED LIGHT, RAIN
menu.desc: Stopped at a red light in the rain, the wiper clearing the glass.

menu.label: B2  LUMA'S, OPEN LATE
menu.desc: Pie and coffee at Luma's, bulbs chasing next door, a sign on the blink.

menu.label: B3  LATE CALLER
menu.desc: A late call on 88.1 Moonlow FM: Rae on the air, Danny out by Exit 4.

menu.label: B4  OVERDRIVE
menu.desc: Into the tunnel in a blaze of light trails, and out onto the freeway.
